Let's Build Your Gaming Identity.

Six short steps turn your gaming journey into a professional profile that teams and organisations can actually discover.

    Step 1 of 6

    Progress saves automatically on this device (demo).

    Step 1 of 6 · Basic Information

    Let's Get to Know You.

    The basics behind the gamer tag — this is how teams and organisations will first meet you.

    ?

    Profile photo

    A clear photo or avatar. Optional — you can change it anytime.

    0/160

    Step 2 of 6 · Gaming Identity

    What's Your Gaming Identity?

    Select all roles that represent your gaming journey.

    Step 3 of 6 · Your Games

    Which Games Do You Play?

    Pick every game you want on your profile — you'll add your rank and role for each one in the next step.

    No games match your search — try a different name.

    Step 4 of 6 · Game Profiles

    Showcase Your Gaming Experience.

    One profile per game. Your in-game name and primary role are required for each game — roles are specific to every title.

    Step 5 of 6 · Achievements & Experience

    Your Journey. Your Achievements.

    Everything here is optional — add what you're proud of, or skip and build it up later.

    Achievements

    Achievements you add are shown as Self-reported. Attaching an evidence link marks them "Evidence attached — verification pending"; Hire4Play only displays a Verified badge after an external check, which doesn't happen in this demo.

    Step 6 of 6 · Connect & Preferences

    Make Your Profile Discoverable.

    Where people can find you, and what you're open to. All social links are optional.

    What are you open to?

    Looking for a teamShow teams that you're searching for a roster spot
    Discover new playersFind and connect with players who match your games and roles
    Join gaming communitiesTake part in communities around your games and goals
    Open to recruitmentOrganisations can approach you with offers
    Available for tournamentsYou're ready to compete in upcoming events
    Open to collaborationsContent, streams and community projects
    Open to coaching or mentoringHelp other players level up

    Profile visibility

    Contact preference (optional)

    Your contact email is never public by default — it is only shared through the contact method you pick above.

        About Me

        Professional bio

        Competitive BGMI player from Hyderabad with three years of structured scrim and tournament experience. I play an aggressive entry role, shot-call mid-game rotations and grind VOD review with my roster every week.

        Gaming journey

        Started in college fest tournaments in 2023, moved into organised Tier-3 scrims in 2024, and now compete in Tier-2 leagues while balancing a BBA degree.

        Gaming interests

        BGMI competitive scene, Valorant ranked, esports analytics, content breakdowns

        Career objectives

        Break into a Tier-1 BGMI roster in 2027, qualify for a national LAN, and build a coaching side-profile for junior players.

        Gaming Experience

        Competitive record at a glance — counted live from the sections below.

        Experience

        3 years competitive · 40+ tournaments & scrim leagues

        Preferred play style

        Aggressive entry fragger — early information, fast rotations, high-risk openers for the team.

        Gaming Identity

        One profile per game — roles and ranks are game-specific, never merged into a single score.

        Skills & Specialisations

        Tags describe what you bring to a roster. Hire4Play never converts them into a universal gaming score.

        Achievements

        Every achievement carries an honesty label: Self-reported · Evidence-backed (proof attached) · Endorsed (confirmed by a teammate or organisation) · Integration-verified (checked against a game integration — not connected in this demo).
